capabilities: Render fixed events and flexible tasks on a spiral timeline inside daily notes
Push unfinished tasks forward and show planned vs. available time and remaining capacity
Track task completion with automatic completion timestamps and optional CLOCK: records
Compare planned and actual time in a daily review
extras: README warns the plugin writes to notes by appending completion timestamps when tasks are checked off (can be disabled); detailed settings, commands, and the execution layer are documented in an external user guide, not the README. It also reads legacy LOGBOOK:: entries.
intentEvidence: ported from 404KSG's roam-nautilus-log for Roam Research
motivation: The author applies YNAB's 'give every dollar a job' budgeting philosophy to time management: 'Give every minute a job.'
problem: Daily notes list tasks but show nothing about how they fit into the day's available time, forcing users to plan time blocks outside Obsidian.

relations.evidence: Original concept & Roam plugin: Nautilus by Tomáš Barys.
Enhanced fork: Nautilus Enhanced by hopeserena.
Inspired by YNAB's core philosophy "Give every dollar a job"

summary: Spiral-timeline time-blocking and daily planning plugin that pins fixed events, schedules flexible tasks into gaps, and pushes unfinished work forward.
